items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: You had an association with Giovanni Bonandrini.

ctx.x: This rock way of playing. He was at the top of rock guitar playing. Lives on a farm in Norway. I’ve lost touch with the boys. I see them now and then. But they do – the Norwegians and Swedes do recognize the contribution to the music in general and the players.

I would say also the Finns, who are Scandinavian as well; the Swedes, as you mentioned; the Germans; the Italians. Ands of course later on, and we’ll get to that, or we can even talk about it now. You had an association with Giovanni Bonandrini.
